paragraphs.text: Genku is a moonfolk wizard from Kamigawa . He was the husband of Tamiyo .

Tamiyo and Genku had several children: among others, their son Hiroku, daughter Rumiyo, and their adopted nezumi son Nashi . Another of their adopted children was a Kitsune . Genku survived the New Phyrexian Invasion , reuniting with Nashi and the memory of Tamiyo.
The tokens created by Genku, Future Shaper (a rat, Nashi; a moonfolk, Hiroku; and a kitsune) represent his and Tamiyo's children.
